en.headline: Wild boar population halves after capture-and-kill policy expanded
en.dek: A Legislative Council research brief showed authorities humanely dispatched 723 wild boars last year, up from 64 in 2021, while the estimated population fell from around 2,000 to 990.
body: Hong Kong’s estimated wild boar population has roughly halved since the government expanded its capture-and-kill programme, according to a Legislative Council research brief published this week.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department humanely dispatched 723 wild boars in 2025, compared with 64 in 2021 when the current policy was reinstated. The estimated population dropped from around 2,000 between 2020 and 2022 to 990 in 2025. Reports of human injuries linked to wild boars also declined sharply over the same period.

The LegCo research office attributed the population decline mainly to the expanded use of lethal control measures. The policy was introduced to address risks including attacks on people, damage to farmland and the potential spread of disease.

zh.headline: 野豬數量減半 當局去年人道處理逾700頭
zh.dek: 立法會研究報告顯示，漁護署去年人道處理723頭野豬，較2021年的64頭大幅增加，估計數目由約2,000頭降至990頭。
body: 立法會研究簡報顯示，自政府擴大捕殺政策後，本港估計野豬數量大致減半。
漁農自然護理署在2025年人道處理723頭野豬，遠高於2021年政策恢復時的64頭。估計野豬數目由2020至2022年間約2,000頭，降至2025年的990頭。同期與野豬相關的人類受傷報告亦明顯減少。
立法會研究部認為，數目下降主要與擴大使用致命控制措施有關。當局推行政策旨在應對野豬襲人、破壞農地及傳播疾病等風險。
